prior: NCI08 96 prospective heldout states ×2 questions established an exact seven-uncompressed-edge information bottleneck: frozen learned graph retainer 96/192 while 12-edge oracle 192/192; previous learned 48/192, FIFO/LRU zero. This disproves generalization of uncompressed graph-retention, NOT of alternative compressive state representations.
hypothesis: Does online native path chunking of publicly observed adjacent pairs into span-two memory items preserve at least 75% of both unknown future four-hop questions with seven stored items and unchanged pretrained Wingless lexical admission, learned join and graph-local retention?
freeze: One deterministic transition: when new observed span-one edge shares an endpoint with a retained span-one edge, replace pair by span-two end-to-end chunk; otherwise admit one span-one link. Frozen original Wingless NCI07 four-weight learned graph scorer resolves overflow, no oracle/future task labels. Retrieval is an explicit span-aware learned-edge-join traversal with exact boundary checks. Compare original seven-uncompressed-edge graph policy on identical stream and separate 12-edge full oracle. No training after source birth. Fresh 30112..30135 × four NCI08 order families, 96 states/192 queries.
criteria: CODED_TWO_LINK_COMPRESSION_RESTORES_BOUNDED_RECALL iff full oracle 192/192 and candidate ≥75% and ≥15pp better than unchanged learned graph retainer. PARTIAL_TWO_LINK_CHUNK_RECALL_GAIN if ≥5pp gain; else negative. All results preserve row-level provenance even if null.
cost_caveat: Seven stored chunk records versus seven original edges is matched by record count ONLY. A five-int Go chunk (about 40 bytes) is larger than a two-int original edge (about 16 bytes), before slice allocations and external structural search compute. Do NOT claim equal physical bytes or equal FLOP. Log actual unsafe.Sizeof, source scoring multiplications, learned join evaluations and merges.
constraints: No unseen target identity or oracle labels at memory decision
Frozen original learned lexical admission and six-weight join
Native bounded seven records, checkpointed via JSON copy, resource reporting
One original heldout first use after prereg; artifact before verdict, full Go regression and no-replay independent archive witness
Do not promote accepted refs, merge or touch FORGE/CKB/KTRADE/production
caveat: The compressor, span arithmetic and retrieval search are PROGRAMMED. Positive outcome would show that compressed representation helps a bounded system, not learned abstraction, NCI01 full acceptance, RSI or AGI. All task families reuse NCI08 grammar; this is mechanistic feasibility not broad transfer.
